title: changeStatus (client → server)
description: Facilitator only (FR-004, FR-026). START: PREPARATION → IN_PROGRESS. CLOSE: IN_PROGRESS → CLOSED, the session becomes read-only for everyone. REOPEN: CLOSED → IN_PROGRESS. An action that changes nothing (START while in progress, REOPEN on a session that is not closed) is accepted without effect. While CLOSED, every intent but REOPEN gets error SESSION_CLOSED; CLOSE on a session in PREPARATION gets error SESSION_NOT_STARTED.
